description: This file defines the Currency class within the OpenCart system, responsible for managing currency data, formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency properties such as symbols and decimal places.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Class for handling currency-related operations such as formatting, converting, and retrieving currency information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the currency object by loading currency data from the database.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string, optionally applying symbol and decimal formatting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a currency amount from one currency to another based on stored exchange rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the currency ID for a given currency code.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Returns the symbol placed to the left of the currency value.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Returns the symbol placed to the right of the currency value.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal places used for a given currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate value for a specific currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a currency exists in the loaded currency data.
